protocol_step: A manual oracle is an expected verdict derived from MITL semantics before reading TAMonitor output.
decision_rule: Use the hand-written rationale, expected_final, expected_prefix, and expected_sat fields as the independent expectation.
pass_condition: Rows counted as runtime correctness must be HAND_ORACLE_VERIFIED; current hand_verified=70.
reject_or_fix_condition: If the expected verdict is copied from TAMonitor output, or the rationale is absent for a claimed runtime row, reject the row and add a real derivation.
reviewer_action: Check that the rationale explains why the formula is true, false, or inconclusive on the timed word.
must_not_claim: Do not call a generated monitor result itself a manual oracle.

protocol_step: The oracle source must be independent of TAMonitor, MoniTAal, stdout parsing, and generated verdict summaries.
decision_rule: Accept the oracle only when the expected value is justified by the MITL formula, interval boundaries, word mode, and timed-word events.
pass_condition: The oracle ledger may compare against TAMonitor after the expectation is stated, but the comparison is not the source of truth.
reject_or_fix_condition: If the rationale says only that TAMonitor or MoniTAal returned the same verdict, classify the row as review-required and add a semantic derivation.
reviewer_action: Trace the expected prefix/final verdict back to MITL semantics before checking the actual output columns.
must_not_claim: Do not use agreement between two implementations as a substitute for a hand oracle.

protocol_step: MoniTAal XML baseline comparisons are trace-level cross-tool evidence, not hand-derived MITL semantic oracles.
decision_rule: Use baseline verdict agreement to check that a candidate MITL monitor matches the XML monitor on the same mapped input; use manual-oracle rows only when the expected verdict is derived from MITL semantics before running either tool.
pass_condition: Rows with oracle_type=monitaal_xml_baseline_same_input may support baseline-match claims, but they do not by themselves prove XML-to-MITL equivalence or hand-oracle correctness.
reject_or_fix_condition: If a paper or review row treats MoniTAal/TAMonitor agreement as a manual oracle, rewrite the claim or add an independent semantic derivation.
reviewer_action: Check whether the cited row is a hand-oracle semantic regression, a MoniTAal baseline comparison, or a structural XML proof obligation before approving the claim.
must_not_claim: Do not call MoniTAal baseline agreement a hand oracle, and do not use it as a substitute for human XML-to-MITL proof review.

protocol_step: For runtime verification, each checked prefix has a three-valued oracle: POSITIVE, NEGATIVE, or INCONCLUSIVE.
decision_rule: A prefix row passes only when expected_prefix_verdict equals actual_prefix_verdict and the observed step exists.
pass_condition: Current prefix rows: matches=146; mismatches=0; missing_observed_steps=0.
reject_or_fix_condition: Any MISMATCH or MISSING_OBSERVED_STEP row is a real correctness blocker until either the hand oracle or implementation bug is fixed.
reviewer_action: Spot-check at least one eventually, globally, until/release, and past-operator prefix sequence.
must_not_claim: Do not use final-verdict agreement as evidence for every prefix when prefix rows are absent or mismatched.

protocol_step: The final oracle is the expected verdict after consuming the shown timed word under the selected finite or infinite word mode.
decision_rule: A final-verdict row passes only when expected_final equals TAMonitor final verdict and no required prefix oracle contradicts it.
pass_condition: Current semantic runtime rows with hand oracles are checked through semantic_oracle_derivations.csv.
reject_or_fix_condition: If expected_final is blank for a runtime claim, keep the row as review-required or build/stat-only.
reviewer_action: Use the word column before deciding whether end-of-word finalization is valid.
must_not_claim: Do not mix finite-word finalization with infinite-word prefix semantics.

protocol_step: SAT/UNSAT is a construction-time formula check, not a replacement for a timed-word runtime oracle.
decision_rule: A SAT expectation may support the pre-run formula check only when expected_sat is explicitly present.
pass_condition: SAT rows are recorded in semantic_oracle_derivations.csv and generated run summary files.
reject_or_fix_condition: If SAT disagrees with a stated expectation, fix the formula/expectation or investigate MightyPPL construction before citing.
reviewer_action: Review SAT disagreement separately from prefix/final verdict disagreement.
must_not_claim: Do not infer trace satisfaction from formula satisfiability alone.

protocol_step: Existing MightyPPL corpus rows with no trace are construction/statistics coverage, not runtime correctness evidence.
decision_rule: Rows with oracle_status=CONSTRUCTION_STATS_ONLY are acceptable only as build/stat coverage.
reject_or_fix_condition: If a paper statement counts build/stat-only rows as runtime verdict correctness, reject or rewrite the claim.
reviewer_action: Keep construction coverage useful but separate from RV correctness counts.
must_not_claim: Do not claim timed-word correctness for rows without a timed word and expected verdict oracle.

protocol_step: Manual review should sample every user-facing operator family represented in the regression suite.
decision_rule: At minimum, inspect F/G/U/R, past O/H/S/T, finite-word rows, and Pnueli Fn/On/Gn/Hn rows.
pass_condition: Syntax coverage and oracle derivations identify the case ids backing each family.
reject_or_fix_condition: If an operator family lacks a readable derivation, add a hand-oracle case before expanding paper claims.
reviewer_action: Use this row to decide which cases to inspect first when reviewing the workbook.
must_not_claim: Do not generalize beyond operator families that have explicit evidence rows.

protocol_step: A mismatch is resolved by fixing the real source: oracle derivation, trace expectation, BDD projection, parser, monitor runner, or report extraction.
decision_rule: After any fix, rerun the full pipeline and require zero mismatches and zero verifier failures.
pass_condition: The current full pipeline records the latest post-fix evidence in pipeline_summary.json.
reject_or_fix_condition: Do not weaken MITL semantics, rewrite expected values to match the tool, or parse stdout as correctness evidence.
reviewer_action: Record the bug cause and verification command in SESSION_LOG.
must_not_claim: Do not leave correctness bugs as manual follow-up without an explicit caveat or failing gate.

protocol_step: Generated oracle ledgers make evidence reviewable; they are not human approval by themselves.
decision_rule: Paper-facing claims need Review Signoff decisions after the reviewer checks linked oracle evidence.
pass_condition: Review Signoff rows intentionally start blank.
reject_or_fix_condition: If reviewer_decision is blank, the result is ready for review but not human-approved.
reviewer_action: Fill reviewer_decision only after checking the cited formula, trace, expected verdict, actual verdict, and evidence artifacts.
must_not_claim: Do not state that human review is complete from generated blank signoff rows.
